body.name: Estimable measurement-support leakage allowances
body.construction:
Fix a positive, training-fold-measurable threshold \(\tau_{S,n}\downarrow0\) that is chosen without the true measurement supports.  In the absence of design-known supports, define
\[
 \widehat\ell_{A,n}(x)=
 \max_{1\leq j\leq K}\sum_{a=1}^K
 \widehat M_A(x)_{aj}\mathbf 1\{\widehat M_A(x)_{aj}\leq\tau_{S,n}\},
 \qquad
 \ell_{A,n}=\|\widehat\ell_{A,n}\|_{L^2(P_X)},
\]
and define \(\widehat\ell_{Z,n}(x)\) and \(\ell_{Z,n}\) analogously from \(\widehat M_Z\).  These fitted low-mass functions are observable and their \(L^2(P_X)\) norms are estimable by foldwise empirical averaging.  If support sets \(S_A(x)\) and \(S_Z(x)\) are supplied as observed design information and the fit is constrained to vanish off those sets, define the corresponding leakage allowance to be zero.  No unknown true support is an input in either case.
